gap_analysis.detail: Learner rates themselves 8/10 but provides only a one-word slogan response without any reasoning, mechanism explanation, trade-off discussion, or transfer application. This suggests either overconfidence, test disengagement, or a mismatch between perceived and actual understanding depth.
gap_analysis.primary_concern: The learner may hold an illusion of explanatory depth — recognizing the correct slogan without being able to articulate the underlying mechanism (why indexes speed up queries, when they fail, the B-tree/哈希 trade-off, or the cost of index maintenance on writes).

diagnostic_hypotheses.evidence: Correct slogan-level answer paired with high self-rating but zero elaboration
Single-word response to a question that invites explanation; no attempt at reasoning
No timing data available; cannot rule out

suggested_prompts: 你回答说索引能加速查询。请解释一下：索引具体是怎么做到这一点的？
假设一张表有千万行数据，你在某个字段上建了索引。什么时候这个索引反而不会被用到？
索引有代价吗？如果有，是什么？
intervention.scaffolding_strategy: 从确认正确的基础口号出发，逐步要求机制解释、边界条件、代价权衡
intervention.rationale: Before advancing, verify whether the learner can move from slogan recognition to mechanistic explanation. If they can, advance with a calibrated confidence adjustment; if they cannot, route back to S3 with targeted content on index internals.

metadata.recommendation: Collect at least one more observation with a why/how prompt before finalizing the mastery estimate. A single slogan answer is insufficient for S4 closure.
